name: Optimize lock-free chunk recipe pressure path

description: Baseline with atomic admission and atomic reverse-reference batches
Reuse decoded chunk identifiers during cascade deletion

asi.hypothesis: Avoiding a second recipe decode should reduce cascade work
asi.result: The median regressed 10.7 percent and a warm confirmation remained slower, so the candidate was discarded
The restored path passed all correctness gates and measured 4.9 percent below the initial baseline; the small confidence score means this is treated as confirmation, not a claimed speedup
